= Reporting Bugs =

We appreciate your input to improve unicase. You are the our most valuable source of bug reports and feature requests. If you find a bug or if you have feature request please do not hesitate to report it to us. Please give us as much information on the feature or bug as you can, in particular the following information is very useful in descending order of priority:

    * The version of unicase the problem occured in
    * Steps to reproduce the problem
    * User Environment: Eclipse version, Java version, OS
    * A screenshot of the error or problem
    * A log entry of the problem
    * A zipped copy of your .unicase folder in your user home

Please send add your bug report in the project "unicase" on our UNICASE beta server. In this project we manage the UNICASE development itself, a.k.a. "Eat your own dog food". Add the bug report or feature request in the section "NEW bug reports" in the Project Management Document. You can assign it preliminarily to Jonas (helming), Maximilian (koegel) or a developer you think is capable of handling or resolving the bug, so you do not see it in your task list anymore.

The bug report process is as follows:

 * Bugs are added in the "NEW bug report" section
 * Bugs are reviewed and moved into the back log to a certain priority set
 * Bugs are moved from the backlog to a sprint in sprint planning
 * Bugs are resolved in the sprint
